module_summary: AXI-stream byte packer: input skid buffer, a combinational stage compacting null (TKEEP=0) bytes plus byte count, a second skid buffer, then a partial-word accumulator merging beats into full output words.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Input stream valid into the slave skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Input stream ready from the slave skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Input stream payload bytes to be compacted.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TSTRB
anchors.why: Input byte strobes carried alongside data through packing.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TKEEP
anchors.why: Input byte keep flags marking which bytes are retained.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: Input packet end marker.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Registered output valid loaded from next_valid when output is free.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Output backpressure; stalls packing, mid_fill and output registers.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Packed output word from mid_data or low half of w_packed_data.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TSTRB
anchors.why: Packed output byte strobes.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TKEEP
anchors.why: Packed output byte keep flags.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: Output packet end, from mid_last flush or next_last.

anchors.name: pck_tdata
anchors.why: Beat with null bytes squeezed out by pack function, fed to beat skid buffer.

anchors.name: pck_count
anchors.why: Popcount of TKEEP giving valid byte count of the packed beat.

anchors.name: skd_count
anchors.why: Registered byte count of current beat; drives fill arithmetic and readiness.

anchors.name: skd_valid
anchors.why: Valid of packed beat from beat skid buffer; gates axis_ready and next_valid.

anchors.name: skd_data
anchors.why: Registered packed beat data shifted into w_packed_data.

anchors.name: axis_ready
anchors.why: Accept of packed beat; drops when accumulator full or ending while output stalled.

anchors.name: mid_fill
anchors.why: Byte occupancy of partial-word buffer; sets shift amount and when a word is complete.

anchors.name: mid_data
anchors.why: Partial-word accumulator holding leftover bytes between output words.

anchors.name: mid_last
anchors.why: Pending final word flag; forces flush of mid_data with TLAST.

anchors.name: w_packed_data
anchors.why: Double-width merge of mid_data with skd_data shifted by mid_fill bytes.

anchors.name: next_valid
anchors.why: Full word or final flush available; loads M_AXIS_TVALID and decrements fill.

anchors.name: next_last
anchors.why: Next output word ends the packet; feeds M_AXIS_TLAST and mid_last.

groups.name: Input skid buffer
groups.description: Registers incoming AXI-stream beats with full-throughput backpressure.

groups.name: Beat packing stage
groups.description: Compacts kept bytes to the low end and counts them, registered via beat skid buffer.

groups.name: Word packing accumulator
groups.description: Accumulates packed beats into full words, tracking fill level and pending last.

groups.name: Output register
groups.description: Registered AXI-stream master outputs loaded when output free.
